entities.name: Nguyễn Văn Đài
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nguyễn Văn Đài is a Vietnamese human rights lawyer, democracy activist and blogger. He was arrested on December 16, 2015, by the Vietnamese authorities and charged under Article 88 for "conducting propaganda against the state". The arrest was condemned by international human rights organisations and elected representatives across the world.
